## Installation instructions (Chrome Web Store)

The easiest way to install this browser extension is through the Chrome Web Store: [see here](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bottle-lookup-for-whiskybase/nngkmbiongkmhiiiblajjiokfllneomm). It may take a few days for a new version to appear there, after it has been released here on GitHub.


## Installation instructions (manual)

Alternatively, if you prefer to download and install it from here: download `whiskybase-chromium-browser-extension-{version}.zip` below and unzip it. Then go to `chrome://extensions` in your web browser, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder.
